purpose: Approved five-parent, five-native-perception-mesh, 750-observation CPU sensor/teacher contract pilot; diagnostic only, with no formal dataset or training.

approval.scope: Exactly five predeclared topology parents, five native perception meshes, 250 canonical anchors, 750 fixed diagnostic observations and two independent CPU raycast scenes; no retries, formal dataset, training, AI labels, Isaac, Gazebo or M-TARE changes.
approval.confirmation_reference: 用户在明确讨论CNN/GNN与下一阶段路线后回复：那就先开始下一阶段的任务吧

governance_note: The existing v3_sensor_smoke_card_v1 intentionally remains a one-world contract. This approved run uses the separately implemented and tested multi-world v3_sensor_contract_pilot_card_v1 schema.

source.license_or_allowed_use: Local research execution only; no verified upstream LICENSE text at the pinned commit, so redistribution and modified-source publication are not authorized.
source.benchmark_exclusion: All M-TARE comparison worlds and existing underground benchmark worlds are excluded from generation recipes, manifests, thresholds and visual development.

generation.retry_policy: No whole-parent retry, alternate seed, replacement family, keep-best selection or scan-quality selection.
generation.variant_policy: One native perception mesh per parent only. No topology-preserving geometry-pair claim before a navigation-grade collision backend exists.

sampling.sensor_contract: Open3D 0.19.0 CPU first-return 16x720 range_m and valid_mask; 0.3--50 m, one return, no noise, robot x-forward/y-left/z-up.
sampling.label_contract: Objective teacher only: 5 m sphere/spline outgoing headings, 8 degree deduplication and 720-bin sigma-3-degree circular Gaussian; full graph/splines never enter student arrays.
sampling.storage_contract: Five world-level compressed diagnostic shards plus explicit JSON/JSONL manifests; 750 loose NPZ files are forbidden; this is not the formal Zarr dataset.

evidence.machine_metrics: Freeze source/environment/tool/seed identities; record graph-family, replay, seed separation, mesh, anchor, range, determinism, branch, clearance, leakage and count checks at parent/anchor/view levels.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Five complete world/TNG/anchor maps plus thirty fixed-scale pages containing all 750 scans in groups of 25, with deterministic ordering and machine-readable provenance; no selected best cases.
evidence.failure_policy: Stop and report on unsupported topology family, failed upstream return, replay/seed-separation drift, mesh read failure, anchor shortage, range/determinism/clearance/branch/leakage failure, missing evidence, timeout or disk breach. Do not retry or lower thresholds.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only frozen E1; 5 mesh worlds, 750 observations and two independent scene passes totaling 17.28 million primary rays; no GPU, AI API, Isaac, Gazebo or training.
